how.title: How it works
how.readyLead: Create your free account and book your first station.
how.s1desc: Browse our two Paris addresses and explore each space with an immersive virtual tour.
how.s2desc: Filter by type (hair, beauty, barber) and book the station that fits your work.
how.s3desc: From half an hour to a monthly plan — pick the duration that suits you, no commitment.
how.s4desc: Arrive in a ready-to-use space: reception, coffee, rest room. You focus on your craft.

testimonials.t1quote: L'Appartement 137 changed the way I work. No more full salon overheads, and my clients love the passage Lemoine vibe.
testimonials.t2quote: The cabin at L'Appartement 80 is perfectly equipped. I book around my appointments — freedom I didn't think possible in this industry.
testimonials.t3quote: The barber chair at Appart 137 is top quality. The team builds a real community — rare in our field.

cgu.intro: These Terms of use govern access to and use of the L'Appartement website and booking application. Using the Service implies acceptance of these Terms.
cgu.a1Body: The Service enables beauty professionals (hair, barber, aesthetics, etc.) to browse spaces, create an account, book a station or cabin, and manage their professional file. The operator provides coworking spaces in Paris 2nd (including 16 passage Lemoine and 80 rue de Cléry).
cgu.a2Body: Access requires an Internet connection. Some features are reserved for authenticated users. The operator aims for continuous availability without guaranteeing uninterrupted service.
cgu.a3Body: Registration is for professionals. Users agree to:
cgu.a3Li1: provide accurate information and keep it up to date;
cgu.a3Li4: upload required compliance documents when requested (contract, ID, company extract, professional insurance).
cgu.a4Body: Bookings follow the packages and prices shown on the Service (half-hour, hour, half-day, day, etc.), which vary by station type (premium, classic, barber, chair, cabin) and location. Amounts are in euros including tax unless stated otherwise. Prices may change; confirmed bookings keep the conditions applicable at validation.
cgu.a5Body: Cancellation or change rules are stated at booking or in the house rules. No-show without timely cancellation may result in full or partial charging of the reserved service.
cgu.a6Body: Users must respect equipment, opening hours, safety and cleanliness rules, and the professional setting. Damage may lead to charging and/or account suspension.
cgu.a7Body: The operator is not liable for misuse of the Service or spaces, network outages, force majeure, or relationships between professionals and their own clients. If liability is engaged, it is limited to amounts paid for the booking concerned, within legal limits.
cgu.a8Body: Service content remains the property of the operator or partners. Users retain ownership of their professional content and grant a limited licence for hosting and processing required by the Service.
cgu.a9Body: The operator may suspend or terminate an account for breach of the Terms, fraud, non-payment or behaviour harming the spaces.
cgu.a10Body: For questions about the Terms, contact us at
